lessons.title: ನೆರವೇರಿಸು (neravērisu) — to carry out (a rite); to perform
lessons.gloss: to carry out (a rite); to perform

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Kannada for a victim, then the Kannada for a forewarning.
ನೆರವೇರಿಸು — neravērisu — "to carry out (a rite); to perform".
ಅರ್ಚಕರು ಮದುವೆಯ ಪೂಜೆಯನ್ನು ನೆರವೇರಿಸಿದರು. arcakaru maduveya pūjeyannu neravērisidaru. The priest performed the wedding puja.
Past (I …): ನೆರವೇರಿಸಿದೆ, neravēriside.
Rites and ceremonies are carried out with it. A wish or a plan that comes true ನೆರವೇರುತ್ತದೆ. Before a rite is carried out, the house is made ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ, spotless.
ನೆರವೇರಿಸು (neravērisu) is usually traced to the native Dravidian neṟe, "to become complete, to be realized, to occur" (DEDR 3682), with the causative ending -isu.
One more word for telling what happened.

segments.instruction: neravērisu
neravērisu, once more
arcakaru maduveya pūjeyannu neravērisidaru. — The priest performed the wedding puja.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: *arcakaru maduveya pūjeyannu neravērisidaru.* — The priest performed the wedding puja.]

segments.text: What does ನೆರವೇರಿಸು (neravērisu) mean? ("To carry out (a rite); to perform".) Say it once more.
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a forewarning, then the Kannada for to carry out.
ಸಮಾರಂಭ — samārambha — "a ceremony; a function".
ಶಾಲೆಯ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಸಮಾರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹಾಡಿದರು. śāleya vārṣika samārambhadalli makkaḷu hāḍidaru. The children sang at the school's annual function.
Plural: ಸಮಾರಂಭಗಳು, samārambhagaḷu.
Any formal gathering: a wedding, a prize-giving, an opening.
ಸಮಾರಂಭ (samārambha) is borrowed from Sanskrit samārambha, "an undertaking, an enterprise" (Monier-Williams); in Kannada it became an organised event.
One more word for telling what happened.

ಅರ್ಪಿಸು — arpisu — "to offer; to dedicate".
ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹಿರಿಯರಿಗೆ ಹೂವು ಅರ್ಪಿಸಿದರು. makkaḷu hiriyarige hūvu arpisidaru. The children offered flowers to the elders.
Past (I …): ಅರ್ಪಿಸಿದೆ, arpiside.
What is offered takes -ಅನ್ನು or stands bare; to whom takes -ಗೆ. Books are dedicated too: ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ಅಮ್ಮನಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಪಿಸು (arpisu).
ಅರ್ಪಿಸು (arpisu) is built on Sanskrit arpaṇa, "procuring, placing upon, handing over" (Monier-Williams), with the Kannada verb ending -isu.
One more word for telling what happened.

lessons.title: ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸು (ērpaḍisu) — to set up; to arrange

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Kannada for a ceremony, then the Kannada for to offer.
ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸು — ērpaḍisu — "to set up; to arrange".
ಅಪ್ಪ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಊಟ ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸಿದರು. appa maduvege ūṭa ērpaḍisidaru. Father arranged the meal for the wedding.
Past (I …): ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸಿದೆ, ērpaḍiside.
ಏರ್ಪಡು is to come about; ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸು (ērpaḍisu) is to make it come about. The noun is ಏರ್ಪಾಡು, an arrangement.
ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸು (ērpaḍisu) is native Dravidian: DEDR 905 lists Kannada ērpaḍu, "to come about", and ērpaḍisu, beside Tamil ēl, "to happen, to be suitable".
One more word for telling what happened.

lessons.title: ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ (āmantraṇa) — an invitation card; an invitation

needs: your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your eyes, so it is not fully a driving lesson. You will want your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach it, but leave this section until you have stopped: You'll want to know: ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ.

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Kannada for to offer, then the Kannada for to set up.
ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ — āmantraṇa — "an invitation card; an invitation".
ಮದುವೆಯ ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ ಅಂಚೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂತು. maduveya āmantraṇa añceyalli bantu. The wedding invitation came by post.
Plural: ಆಮಂತ್ರಣಗಳು, āmantraṇagaḷu.
In full the printed card is ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ (āmantraṇa) ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ; ಆಹ್ವಾನ is the general word for an invitation.
ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ (āmantraṇa) is borrowed from Sanskrit āmantraṇa, "addressing, calling to, summoning" (Monier-Williams).
One more word for telling what happened.

segments.text: Meanwhile? (ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ, aṣṭaralli.) All of a sudden? (ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ, haṭhāttāgi.) At once? (ಕೂಡಲೇ, kūḍalē.) Abruptly? (ಏಕಾಏಕಿ, ēkāēki.) To be startled? (ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು, beccibīḷu.) A robbery? (ದರೋಡೆ, darōḍe.) To loot? (ದೋಚು, dōcu.) To commit? (ಎಸಗು, esagu.) To abscond? (ಪರಾರಿಯಾಗು, parāriyāgu.) A track? (ಜಾಡು, jāḍu.) The media? (ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ, mādhyama.) A TV channel? (ವಾಹಿನಿ, vāhini.) A news bulletin? (ವಾರ್ತೆ, vārte.) To announce? (ಘೋಷಿಸು, ghōṣisu.) A statement? (ಹೇಳಿಕೆ, hēḷike.) To collide? (ಡಿಕ್ಕಿ ಹೊಡೆ, ḍikki hoḍe.) An eyewitness? (ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷದರ್ಶಿ, pratyakṣadarśi.) Damage? (ಹಾನಿ, hāni.) The deceased? (ಮೃತ, mṛta.) A mishap? (ಅವಘಡ, avaghaḍa.) Once before? (ಹಿಂದೊಮ್ಮೆ, hindomme.) On that day? (ಅಂದು, andu.) A long time? (ಬಹುಕಾಲ, bahukāla.) Ancient? (ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ, prācīna.) An era? (ಯುಗ, yuga.) A disaster? (ವಿಪತ್ತು, vipattu.) To be caught? (ಸಿಲುಕು, siluku.) To survive? (ಬದುಕುಳಿ, badukuḷi.) A victim? (ಸಂತ್ರಸ್ತ, santrasta.) A forewarning? (ಮುನ್ಸೂಚನೆ, munsūcane.) To carry out? (ನೆರವೇರಿಸು, neravērisu.) A ceremony? (ಸಮಾರಂಭ, samārambha.) To offer? (ಅರ್ಪಿಸು, arpisu.) To set up? (ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸು, ērpaḍisu.) An invitation card? (ಆಮಂತ್ರಣ, āmantraṇa.)
